title: 送错的包裹
summary: A mistaken parcel delivery brings three neighbors together and reveals a thoughtful surprise.
topic: A parcel delivered to the wrong apartment

blocks.hanzi: 小雨住在一座公寓里。
blocks.translation: Xiaoyu lives in an apartment.
blocks.pinyin: Xiǎo Yǔ zhù zài yī zuò gōngyù lǐ.

blocks.hanzi: 一天下午，她收到一个快递。
blocks.translation: One afternoon, she received a package.
blocks.pinyin: yītiān xiàwǔ ， tā shōudào yīgè kuàidì 。

blocks.hanzi: 她打开包裹，发现是一个漂亮的蛋糕。
blocks.translation: She opened the package and found it was a beautiful cake.
blocks.pinyin: tā dǎkāi bāoguǒ, fāxiàn shì yīgè piàoliang de dàngāo.

blocks.hanzi: 这个蛋糕是谁的？我没有买蛋糕。
blocks.translation: Whose cake is this? I didn't buy a cake.
blocks.pinyin: zhège dàngāo shì shuí de? wǒ méiyǒu mǎi dàngāo.

blocks.hanzi: 她看了看包裹上的门牌，发现送错了。
blocks.translation: She looked at the address plate on the package and found it was delivered wrong.
blocks.pinyin: tā kàn le kàn bāoguǒ shàng de ménpái, fāxiàn sòngcuò le.

blocks.hanzi: 小雨决定把包裹还给真正的邻居。
blocks.translation: Xiaoyu decided to return the package to the real neighbor.
blocks.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ juédìng bǎ bāoguǒ huán gěi zhēnzhèng de línjū.

blocks.hanzi: 她按照门牌，找到了楼上的大明。
blocks.translation: She followed the doorplate and found Daming upstairs.
blocks.pinyin: tā ànzhào mén pái ， zhǎo dào le lóu shàng de dà míng 。

blocks.hanzi: 你好，这是你的快递吗？
blocks.translation: Hello, is this your express delivery?
blocks.pinyin: nǐ hǎo , zhè shì nǐ de kuài dì ma ?

blocks.hanzi: 不是我的。我也收到了一个送错的包裹。
blocks.translation: It's not mine. I also received a misdelivered package.
blocks.pinyin: búshì wǒ de . wǒ yě shōudào le yí gè sòngcuò de bāoguǒ .

blocks.hanzi: 大明看了看包裹，说这个蛋糕应该是楼下王奶奶的。
blocks.translation: Daming looked at the package and said this cake should be Grandma Wang's downstairs.
blocks.pinyin: Dàmíng kàn le kàn bāoguǒ, shuō zhège dàngāo yīnggāi shì lóuxià Wáng nǎinai de.

blocks.hanzi: 小雨和大明一起下楼，找到了王奶奶。
blocks.translation: Xiaoyu and Daming went downstairs together and found Grandma Wang.
blocks.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ hé Dàmíng yìqǐ xiàlóu, zhǎodào le Wáng nǎinai.

blocks.hanzi: 王奶奶，这个蛋糕是您的吗？
blocks.translation: Grandma Wang, is this cake yours?
blocks.pinyin: Wáng nǎinai, zhège dàngāo shì nín de ma?

blocks.hanzi: 您订了这个蛋糕吗？
blocks.translation: Did you order this cake?
blocks.pinyin: nín dìng le zhè ge dàn gāo ma ?

blocks.hanzi: 王奶奶很惊讶，说她没有订蛋糕。
blocks.translation: Grandma Wang was very surprised, saying that she did not order a cake.
blocks.pinyin: Wáng nǎinai hěn jīngyà, shuō tā méiyǒu dìng dàngāo.

blocks.hanzi: 小雨发现包裹上还有一张卡片。
blocks.translation: Xiaoyu found that there was also a card on the package.
blocks.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ fāxiàn bāoguǒ shàng háiyǒu yī zhāng kǎpiàn.

blocks.hanzi: 卡片上写着：“祝王奶奶生日快乐！——您的女儿。”
blocks.translation: The card reads: “Happy birthday, Grandma Wang! — Your daughter.”
blocks.pinyin: kǎpiàn shàng xiě zhe: “zhù Wáng nǎinai shēngrì kuàilè!——nín de nǚ'ér.”

blocks.hanzi: 王奶奶，今天是您的生日吗？
blocks.translation: Grandma Wang, is today your birthday?
blocks.pinyin: Wáng nǎinai, jīntiān shì nín de shēngrì ma?

blocks.hanzi: 生日快乐！我们陪您吃蛋糕吧！
blocks.translation: Happy birthday! We'll have cake with you!
blocks.pinyin: shēngrì kuàilè! wǒmen péi nín chī dàngāo ba!

blocks.hanzi: 王奶奶这才想起今天是自己的生日。
blocks.translation: Grandma Wang only then remembered that today is her own birthday.
blocks.pinyin: Wáng nǎinai zhè cái xiǎngqǐ jīntiān shì zìjǐ de shēngrì.

blocks.hanzi: 王奶奶，您忘了自己的生日吗？
blocks.translation: Grandma Wang, have you forgotten your birthday?
blocks.pinyin: Wáng nǎinai, nín wàng le zìjǐ de shēngrì ma?

blocks.hanzi: 王奶奶很高兴，打开了蛋糕。
blocks.translation: Grandma Wang was very happy and opened the cake.
blocks.pinyin: Wáng nǎinai hěn gāoxìng, dǎkāi le dàngāo.

blocks.hanzi: 三个人一起分享蛋糕，有说有笑。
blocks.translation: Three people shared a cake together, chatting and laughing.
blocks.pinyin: sān gè rén yì qǐ fēn xiǎng dàn gāo ， yǒu shuō yǒu xiào 。

blocks.hanzi: 后来，小雨发现自己的包裹也送错了。
blocks.translation: Later, Xiaoyu discovered that her own package was also delivered incorrectly.
blocks.pinyin: hòulái, xiǎoyǔ fāxiàn zìjǐ de bāoguǒ yě sòng cuò le.

blocks.hanzi: 她联系了快递公司，很快收到了正确的包裹。
blocks.translation: She contacted the courier company and soon received the correct package.
blocks.pinyin: tā liánxì le kuàidì gōngsī ， hěn kuài shōudào le zhèngquè de bāoguǒ 。

blocks.hanzi: 这次送错的经历，让小雨和大明成为了好朋友。
blocks.translation: This mistaken delivery experience made Xiaoyu and Daming become good friends.
blocks.pinyin: zhè cì sòng cuò de jīng lì ， ràng Xiǎo Yǔ hé Dà Míng chéng wéi le hǎo péng yǒu 。

blocks.hanzi: 王奶奶也多了两个关心她的邻居。
blocks.translation: Grandma Wang also gained two neighbors who care about her.
blocks.pinyin: Wáng nǎinai yě duō le liǎng gè guānxīn tā de línjū.

blocks.hanzi: 小雨觉得，虽然送错了，但这是一个温暖的惊喜。
blocks.translation: Xiaoyu felt that although it was delivered wrong, it was a warm surprise.
blocks.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ juéde, suīrán sòngcuò le, dàn zhè shì yī ge wēnnuǎn de jīngxǐ.
